title: Container Bookings: confirmation time and loading protection by tier
content:
## Scope
This card covers the Container Bookings product line and gives each tier's maximum time to answer a booking request, whether its confirmed space is guaranteed against overbooking rolls, and its loading priority rank.

## What each setting means
- **Confirmation time limit**: the maximum number of hours from receipt of a booking request to its confirmation or decline.
- **Space guaranteed**: whether confirmed space is guaranteed against overbooking rolls.
- **Loading priority rank**: the order in which bookings are protected when a sailing is overbooked; rank 1 is protected first.

## Tier card
| Tier | Confirmation time limit (hours) | Space guaranteed | Loading priority rank |
|---|---|---|---|
| AHL Spot Saver | 24 | no | 6 |
| AHL Spot Flex | 24 | no | 5 |
| AHL Contract Booking | 12 | no | 4 |
| AHL Contract Priority | 8 | no | 3 |
| AHL Guaranteed Loading | 4 | yes | 2 |
| AHL Premium Express | 2 | yes | 1 |

## Points of judgement
**Which bookings are protected first on an overbooked sailing?** AHL Premium Express (rank 1), then AHL Guaranteed Loading (rank 2), AHL Contract Priority (3), AHL Contract Booking (4), AHL Spot Flex (5) and AHL Spot Saver (6) last.

**Which tiers carry guaranteed space?** Only AHL Guaranteed Loading and AHL Premium Express.

## Hypothetical illustration
*Hypothetical timing, for illustration only:* an AHL Guaranteed Loading request received at 09:00 must be confirmed or declined no later than 13:00 the same day, four hours after receipt; the same request under AHL Spot Saver would have up to 24 hours.
